title: LisseNormalizedTowerLocalModels
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme and g:Y -> X an immersion. Let d be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and M a normalized adic tower [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower] whose cohomology lies in [a,b], a <= b, at all levels. Suppose every cohomology sheaf of every level restricted to Y is relatively finite lisse over the inverse-image constant quotient coefficient ring. There is a covering sieve on the final object of Y's pro-etale site such that on each member U there is a single complex L over the inverse image of the completed coefficients on X. Its terms vanish outside [a,b], are relatively adic lisse, and its finite reductions have relatively finite-lisse cohomology. There are isomorphisms e_n from the reductions of L to the restricted M_n. For every m >= n, e_m followed by the restricted tower transition equals the local reduction transition followed by scalar restriction of e_n. No global stratification is asserted; the final inverse-isomorphism square is not part of this construction.

source.place: Tags 09BV and 09AV; local-effectivity steps 4--7, simultaneous trivializations, algebraic reconstruction and relative realization

proof.text: Use the algebraic derived presentation on its covering sieve to obtain E with pseudo-coherence and cohomological bounds. Choose the exact relative completed realization c. Truncate a finite-free representative of E above b and below a to obtain a bounded finite module complex P in precisely [a,b]. Apply c termwise to form L. The exact functor factorization and Q(P)≅E give one derived isomorphism Q(L)≅c_D(E). Apply every quotient functor to it and compose with the presentation isomorphisms. The finite terms become relatively adic lisse; transport finite-lisse reduction cohomology through these isomorphisms. Naturality of the scalar-extension adjunct is the forward quotient square, so composing gives the claimed compatibility for all m≥n.

    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbounded : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)))
    (hlisse : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))) :
    ∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ Y.ProEt), V ∈ ProEt.topology Y (⊤_ Y.ProEt) ∧
      ∀ (U : Y.ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ Y.ProEt), V f →
        ∃ L : CochainComplex (pbcModules U.left
            ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).obj (pbcAdicCompletion X d))) ℤ,
          (∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) → IsZero (L.X q)) ∧
          (∀ q : ℤ, @IsRelativelyAdicLisseModule _ _ (U.hom ≫ g) A _
            d.noetherian d.ideal
            ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
              (pbcCompletedComparison X d).hom)).obj (L.X q))) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
            IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule (U.hom ≫ g) (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
              ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                    (adicTowerLocalReduction d (U.hom ≫ g) L n)))) ∧
          ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, adicTowerLocalReduction d (U.hom ≫ g) L n ≅
              (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj
                (M.level n),
            ∀ (m n : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m),
              (e m).hom ≫ adicTowerRestrictedTransition d (U.hom ≫ g) M m n hnm =
                adicTowerLocalTransition d (U.hom ≫ g) L m n hnm ≫

                    (pbcAdicQuotient X d m n hnm))).map (e n).hom
